units.literal: Thereupon he greatly gathered riches; through Liu Gui he bribed Rong's key men and came fully to know their intentions.

units.zh: 時州庫角無故自鳴，神武異之，無幾而孝莊誅榮。
units.en: About then a horn in the provincial storehouse sounded of its own accord; Gao Huan took it for an omen—and soon Emperor Xiaozhuang killed Erzhu Rong.
units.literal: At the time the horn of the provincial storehouse spontaneously sounded without cause; Shenwu took it as strange; before long Xiaozhuang executed Rong.

units.zh: 因隨榮之廄。
units.en: He then followed Rong into the stables.
units.literal: Thereupon he followed Rong to the stables.

units.zh: 廄有惡馬，榮命翦之。
units.en: A vicious stallion was in the stable, and Rong ordered its mane clipped.
units.literal: In the stable there was a vicious horse; Rong ordered its mane clipped.

units.zh: 榮遂坐神武於床下，屏左右而訪時事。
units.en: Rong then seated Gao Huan below his couch, dismissed his attendants, and questioned him on the state of the realm.
units.literal: Rong thereupon seated Shenwu below his couch, dismissed those on either side, and inquired about current affairs.

units.zh: 榮曰：「但言爾意。」
units.en: Rong replied, "Tell me what you have in mind."
units.literal: Rong said: "Just speak your mind."

units.zh: 榮大悅，語自日中至夜半，乃出。
units.en: Rong was delighted; they talked from noon until midnight before Gao Huan left.
units.literal: Rong was greatly pleased; they spoke from midday until midnight before he departed.

units.zh: 後從榮徙據幷州，抵揚州邑人龐蒼鷹，止團焦中。
units.en: Later, when Rong shifted his base to Bing Province, Gao Huan stayed with Pang Cangying of Yangzhou township in a round-walled compound called Tuanjiao.
units.literal: Later following Rong he moved to hold Bing Province, arrived at Pang Cangying of Yangzhou township, and lodged in a round walled compound.

units.zh: 榮以神武為前鋒。
units.en: Rong made Gao Huan his vanguard.
units.literal: Rong made Shenwu vanguard.

units.zh: 及帝暴崩，榮遂入洛，因將篡位。
units.en: When the emperor died suddenly, Rong entered Luoyang and prepared to seize the throne himself.
units.literal: When the emperor suddenly died, Rong then entered Luoyang and intended to usurp the throne.

units.zh: 榮嘗問左右曰：「一日無我，誰可主軍？」
units.en: Rong once asked his companions, "If I were gone, who could lead these armies?"
units.literal: Rong once asked those beside him: "One day without me — who could command the army?"

units.zh: 以明公雄武，乘時奮發，討鄭儼、徐紇而清帝側，霸業可舉鞭而成。
units.en: With your might, my lord, rise now, strike down Zheng Yan and Xu He, cleanse the emperor's side—and dominion over the realm is yours at a flick of the whip.
units.literal: With your heroic martial power, sir, if you seize the moment and strike, punish Zheng Yan and Xu He and cleanse the emperor's side — hegemony can be achieved at a flick of the whip.

units.zh: 皆稱尒朱兆。
units.en: All named Erzhu Zhao.
units.literal: All named Erzhu Zhao.

units.zh: 因誡兆曰：「爾非其匹，終當為其穿鼻。」
units.en: He warned Zhao, "You are no match for him; in the end he will put the ring in your nose."
units.literal: He thereupon warned Zhao: "You are not his match; in the end you will be bridled by him."

units.zh: 至上黨，明帝又私詔停之。
units.en: When the army reached Shangdang, the emperor secretly ordered a halt.
units.literal: Reaching Shangdang, Ming again privately ordered him to halt.

units.zh: 曰：「此正可統三千騎以還，堪代我主衆者，唯賀六渾耳。」
units.en: Rong said, "Zhao can lead three thousand horsemen home, but only Heiliuhun is fit to replace me in command of the host."
units.literal: He said: "This one can just lead three thousand cavalry back; the man fit to replace me in commanding the masses is only Heiliuhun."

units.zh: 神武諫，恐不聽，請鑄像卜之，鑄不成，乃止。
units.en: Gao Huan remonstrated; fearing Rong would not heed him, he had a Buddha image cast for divination—and when the casting failed, Rong abandoned the plan.
units.literal: Shenwu remonstrated; fearing he would not listen, he asked to cast an image and divined by it; the casting did not succeed, and so Rong stopped.

units.zh: 十一月乙卯，以右丞相、咸陽王斛律金爲左丞相，以錄尚書事、常山王演爲太傅，以司徒、長廣王湛爲太尉，以司空段韶爲司徒，以平陽王淹爲司空，高陽王湜爲尚書左僕射，河間王孝琬爲司州牧，侍中燕子獻爲右僕射。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the yimao day, Hulu Jin, Prince of Xianyang and right chief minister, was appointed left chief minister; Prince Yan of Changshan, recorder of the Masters of Writing, became grand tutor; Prince Zhan of Changguang, minister over the masses, became grand commandant; Duan Shao, minister of works, became minister over the masses; Prince Yan of Pingyang became minister of works; Prince Shi of Gaoyang became left vice-director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Xiaowan of Hejian became governor of Sizhou; and Yanzi Xian, palace attendant, became right vice-director.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the yimao day, the right chief minister, Prince of Xianyang Hulu Jin, was made left chief minister; Prince Yan of Changshan, recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing, was made grand tutor; Prince Zhan of Changguang, minister over the masses, was made grand commandant; Duan Shao, minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Prince Yan of Pingyang was made minister of works; Prince Shi of Gaoyang was made left vice-director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was made governor of Sizhou; and Yanzi Xian, attendant at the palace, was made right vice-director.

units.zh: 榮敗，隨尒朱榮，為別將討元顥，以功封敷城縣男。
units.en: When Rong was defeated he followed Erzhu Rong, served as a separate commander against Yuan Hao, and for merit was enfeoffed baron of Fucheng County.
units.literal: When Rong was defeated he followed Erzhu Rong, served as a separate commander against Yuan Hao, and for merit was enfeoffed Baron of Fucheng County.

units.zh: 孝瑜母，魏吏部尚書宋弁孫也，本魏潁川王斌之妃，為文襄所納，生孝瑜，孝瑜還第，為太妃。
units.en: Xiaoyu's mother was a granddaughter of Song Bian, Wei's Minister of Personnel. She had originally been consort to Prince Bin of Yingchuan in Wei, but Wenxiang took her into his household and she bore Xiaoyu. When Xiaoyu took up residence in his own mansion, she became Grand Consort.
units.literal: Xiaoyu's mother was the granddaughter of Song Bian, Minister of Personnel under Wei. She had originally been the consort of Prince Bin of Yingchuan in Wei; Wenxiang took her into his household, and she bore Xiaoyu. When Xiaoyu returned to his residence, she became Grand Consort.

units.zh: 令楊愔傳旨，謂國子助教許散愁曰：「先生在世何以自資？」
units.en: He had Yang Yin deliver his message to Xu Sanchou, assistant instructor at the National University: "Sir, how do you occupy yourself in this life?"
units.literal: He had Yang Yin convey the imperial message and say to National University assistant instructor Xu Sanchou, "Sir, in this life by what do you support yourself?"

units.zh: 乙巳，太師、常山王演矯詔誅尚書令楊愔、尚書右僕射燕子獻、領軍大將軍可朱渾天和、侍中宋欽道、散騎常侍鄭子默。
units.en: On the yisi day Prince Yan of Changshan, grand preceptor, forged an edict and had executed Yang Yin, director of the Masters of Writing; Yanzi Xian, right vice-director; Kezhuhun Tianhe, commanding general of the palace guards; Song Qindao, palace attendant; and Zheng Zimo, attendant of the scattered cavalry.
units.literal: On the yisi day the grand preceptor, Prince of Changshan Yan, forged an edict and executed Yang Yin, director of the Masters of Writing; Yanzi Xian, right vice-director of the Masters of Writing; Kezhuhun Tianhe, general-in-chief commanding the guards; Song Qindao, attendant at the palace; and Zheng Zimo, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry.

units.zh: 及承大位，楊愔、燕子獻、宋欽道等同輔。
units.en: When he came to the throne, Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Song Qindao, and others served jointly as his advisers.
units.literal: When he inherited the great throne, Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Song Qindao, and others assisted him together.

units.zh: 以常山王地親望重，內外畏服，加以文宣初崩之日，太后本欲立之，故愔等並懷猜忌。
units.en: Prince Yan of Changshan was a close kinsman with formidable prestige, feared and obeyed at court and beyond. Since the empress dowager had originally wanted to enthrone him when Emperor Wenxuan died, Yang Yin and the others all suspected him.
units.literal: Because the Prince of Changshan was close in kinship and weighty in reputation, and those within and without feared and submitted to him, and because on the day Emperor Wenxuan first died the empress dowager had originally wanted to enthrone him, Yin and the others all harbored suspicion.

units.zh: 股肱輔弼，雖懷厥誠，旣不能贊弘道德，和睦親懿，又不能遠慮防身，深謀衛主，應斷不斷，自取其咎。
units.en: His chief ministers may have been sincere, but they could not help him enlarge the Way and virtue or keep harmony among his kin. Nor could they plan far enough to protect themselves or safeguard their lord. When decision was needed they failed to decide, and brought disaster on themselves.
units.literal: His chief ministers and assistants, although they held sincere intentions, could neither assist him in magnifying the Way and virtue and harmonizing his close kin, nor plan farsightedly to protect themselves and deeply scheme to safeguard their lord; when they should have acted decisively they did not, and brought blame upon themselves.

units.zh: 臣旣誅夷，君壽廢辱，皆任非其器之所致爾。
units.en: The ministers were exterminated, and the ruler, though still alive, was deposed and humiliated. All of it came from entrusting affairs to men unequal to the task.
units.literal: The ministers were already executed and wiped out, while the ruler, though alive, was deposed and humiliated; all this came from entrusting office to men who were not equal to the task.

units.zh: 壬寅，魏帝詔太原公洋攝理軍國，遣中使敦喻。
units.en: On renyin day the emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang administer military and state affairs and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.
units.literal: On renyin the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Yang administer military and state affairs, and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.

units.zh: 時太原公洋在城東雙堂，入而討賊，臠割京等，皆漆其頭。
units.en: At the time Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.
units.literal: At the time Prince of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.

units.zh: 丙戌，以兼尚書右僕射趙彥深為左僕射。
units.en: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Vice Director Zhao Yanshen was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Deputy Director Zhao Yanshen was appointed Left Deputy Director.

units.zh: 郭秀 和士開 穆提婆 高阿那肱 韓鳳 韓寶業等
units.en: Guo Xiu, He Shikai, Mu Tipo, Gao Anagujin, Han Feng, Han Baoye, and the like
units.literal: Guo Xiu, He Shikai, Mu Tipo, Gao Anagujin, Han Feng, Han Baoye, and others

units.zh: 郭秀，范陽涿人。
units.en: Guo Xiu was from Zhuo in Fanyang.
units.literal: Guo Xiu was a native of Zhuo in Fanyang.

units.zh: 高祖、世宗，情存庶政，文武任寄，多貞幹之臣，唯郭秀小人，有累明德。
units.en: Under Gaozu and Shizong, government still had substance and upright men filled military and civil posts—only the petty Guo Xiu tarnished their good name.
units.literal: Gaozu and Shizong still cared for common governance; in the civil and military posts they employed many upright, resolute ministers—only the petty man Guo Xiu marred their bright virtue.

units.zh: 事高祖為行臺右丞，親寵日隆，多受賂遺。
units.en: Serving Gaozu as Right Director of the Mobile Secretariat, he won ever greater personal favor and took bribes freely.
units.literal: He served Gaozu as Right Director of the Mobile Secretariat; the emperor's personal favor for him grew daily, and he frequently accepted bribes.

units.zh: 乃啟為七兵尚書，除書未至而卒。
units.en: He asked to be made Director of the Seven Armies, but died before the appointment reached him.
units.literal: He requested appointment as Director of the Seven Armies; the commission had not arrived before he died.

units.zh: 命其子孝義與太原公已下同學讀書。
units.en: He had Xiu's son Xiaoyi study alongside the Prince of Taiyuan and his classmates.
units.literal: He ordered Xiu's son Xiaoyi to study together with the Prince of Taiyuan and those below him.

units.zh: 家無成人子弟，高祖自至其宅，親使錄知其家資粟帛多少，然後去。
units.en: The family had no grown sons; Gaozu went to the house himself, had its grain and silk inventoried, and only then departed.
units.literal: His household had no adult sons or younger brothers; Gaozu went in person to his residence and had someone record how much grain, silk, and cloth the family possessed, and only then left.

units.zh: 初，秀忌楊愔，誑脅令其逃亡。
units.en: Earlier, Xiu had resented Yang Yin and tricked and intimidated him into fleeing.
units.literal: Earlier, Xiu resented Yang Yin and deceived and threatened him into fleeing.

units.zh: 秀遇疾，高祖親臨視之，問所欲官。
units.en: When Xiu fell ill, Gaozu visited him in person and asked what post he wanted.
units.literal: When Xiu fell ill, Gaozu personally visited him and asked what office he desired.

units.zh: 秀死後，愔還，高祖追忿秀，卽日斥孝義，終身不齒。
units.en: When Yin returned after Xiu's death, Gaozu, still angry at Xiu, that same day expelled Xiaoyi and never admitted him to polite society again.
units.literal: After Xiu died, Yin returned; Gaozu, reflecting angrily on Xiu, that very day cast out Xiaoyi and for life counted him unworthy of company.

units.zh: 高仲密之叛也，與大司馬斛律金守河陽。
units.en: When Gao Zhongmi rebelled, he and Grand Marshal Hulu Jin guarded Heyang.
units.literal: When Gao Zhongmi rebelled, he and Grand Marshal Hulu Jin guarded Heyang.

units.zh: 高昂望之不見，哭曰：「喪吾弟矣！」
units.en: Gao Ao looked and could not see him; he wept and said, "I have lost my brother!"
units.literal: Gao Ao looked and did not see him; he wept and said: "I have lost my brother!"
